tw: In the green meadow, Kron feeds three sheep, so the sheep sleep on his feet.
twc: 在绿草地上，Kron 喂了三只羊，羊就睡在他脚上。

tw: As the mercury climbs, Kron and his furry cat hurry into the fridge to purr.
twc: 水银柱一路往上窜，Kron 和毛茸茸的猫赶紧钻进冰箱。

tw: In the midst of the mist, Kron's fish gives him a kiss on the wrist.
twc: 在一片迷雾当中，Kron 的鱼跳起来亲了他手腕一下。

tw: Kron squeezes into a miniature tin inn, and his chin sticks out of the window.
twc: Kron 硬挤进一座迷你铁皮旅馆，下巴从窗口伸了出来。

tw: Kron's misery: he misses the bus by a whisker, and this is the very last bus.
twc: Kron 的痛苦：差一根胡须没赶上公交，还是末班车。

tw: The castle mistress in a big dress beats Kron at chess, and Kron's in distress.
twc: 城堡女主人穿着大裙子，下棋赢了 Kron，Kron 急坏了。

tw: Kron moans alone on a stone: "Oh no, my ice cream cone is gone!"
twc: Kron 独自坐在石头上哀嚎：“哦不，我的冰淇淋没了！”

tw: A mob of crabs robs Kron's corn on the cob, and Kron sobs.
twc: 一群螃蟹抢走了 Kron 的玉米棒，Kron 哭了。
hint: 暴民是螃蟹，赃物是玉米。

tw: A clock mocks Kron: "Tick-tock, your sock is on a rock!"
twc: 钟嘲笑 Kron：“嘀嗒嘀嗒，你的袜子在石头上！”

tw: With modesty, Kron nods: his odd, wobbly rod just caught a giant cod.
twc: Kron 谦虚地点点头：他那根歪扭的鱼竿钓到了大鳕鱼。

tw: In the alley, Kron's pal Sally the kitty gives him a morality talk about his fish.
twc: 小巷里，猫朋友莎莉为了那条鱼给 Kron 上道德课。

tw: Mortal Kron wants more, so he climbs four tall doors and roars at the storm.
twc: 凡人 Kron 还想要更多，爬上四扇高门对着暴风雨大吼。

tw: At the motel, Kron rings the bell, and a slow snail at the desk says no.
twc: 在汽车旅馆，Kron 按了铃，前台慢吞吞的蜗牛说没房。

tw: Kron hits mute on his flute, but a cute newt in a suit keeps tooting.
twc: Kron 把长笛静了音，穿西装的小蝾螈还在使劲吹。

tw: In his hut, Kron mutters to his nut butter, but the nut butter won't spread.
twc: Kron 在小屋里对着坚果酱嘟囔，可它就是抹不开。

tw: Naive Kron believes a magpie and hides his pie up his sleeve.
twc: 天真的 Kron 听信喜鹊，把馅饼藏进了袖子里。

tw: The damage is negligible: just one egg on Kron's leg and a peg on his nose.
twc: 损失可以忽略：只是腿上一个蛋，鼻子上一个夹子。

tw: Nick the duck flicks a nickel into Kron's pickle jar, quick, quick!
twc: 鸭子尼克把一枚镍币弹进 Kron 的泡菜罐，快快快！

tw: Notorious Kron snores so loud at story time that four kids and the floor shake.
twc: 出了名的 Kron 在故事会上打呼，震得四个孩子和地板直抖。

tw: Kron takes an oath with both paws up, and a goat eats his oatcake.
twc: Kron 举起双爪发誓，一只山羊吃了他的燕麦饼。
